text:
maya.g: Heads-up — SAST pipeline started failing on main for microservice-auth right after yesterday's KMS rotation. Log: ```Error: AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/infra-ci is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/key-01234```

jonathan.k: Was the rotation the automated one at 22:10? @samir-sec any RBAC policy changes?

samir-sec: Yep, rotated at 22:10. I updated key policy to tighten principals but I may have missed adding the infra CI role back. Looking now.

maya.g: CI job failing step: `sast-scan` — it crashes early so merges are blocked. Build link: https://ci.redwood.dev/builds/8421

eva-sre: This is blocking merges — treat as Sev2. Short-term options: revert rotation or temporarily grant kms:Decrypt to infra-ci. Which is faster?

samir-sec: Granting decrypt back is quicker. I'll add `kms:Decrypt` and `kms:GenerateDataKey` for `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/infra-ci` in the key policy and push.

ops-bot: Deploy policy change detected: key/key-01234 update queued by samir-sec.

security-bot: New audit ticket created: SEC-452 — KMS policy change detected in prod. Auto-attached metadata: rotation=true, author=samir-sec.

jonathan.k: After change, can someone re-run the pipeline? @maya.g please ping when you start.

maya.g: Re-run kicked off. Build #8421 re-run started.

ops-bot: Build #8421 (re-run) finished — sast-scan completed with results.

maya.g: SAST finished but flagged one finding in `auth/token_utils.py`: "Potential unsafe token parsing". Low confidence per vendor: likely FP. Snippet: ```def parse_token(t):\n    try:\n        return jwt.decode(t)  # no verification here, verification happens in validate() later\n    except Exception:\n        return None```

samir-sec: Share full finding output?

maya.g: Attached in CI artifacts: https://ci.redwood.dev/artifacts/8421/sast-report.json

jonathan.k: Looks like the scanner flagged a decode without verification. In our flow we intentionally decode unverified to inspect header claims, and then call `validate()` which verifies signature. We should add a suppression with rationale + unit test to ensure validate() is always called.

eva-sre: For traceability: suppression needs a short security review note and link to the KMS incident. Also attach the KMS policy diff to SEC-452. @samir-sec can you open the PR for the suppression + test?

samir-sec: Opening PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/microservice-auth/pull/678 — adds a SAST suppression rule for CWE-xxxx with explanation, and a unit test verifying `validate()` is invoked. Includes policy diff in ticket SEC-452.

maya.g: ACK. We'll wait for CI on that PR. Also created incident INC-2026 to track pipeline outage (current downtime so far ~18m). If >30m we'll do a short postmortem.

security-bot: Reminder: attach KMS policy change diff and PR link to SEC-452 and add `security:review` label to PR.

jonathan.k: Action list: 1) Ensure `infra-ci` IAM role has explicit kms:Decrypt in central IAM-managed policy (samir-sec). 2) Add automated post-rotation smoke test to verify KMS access for CI (eva-sre). 3) Merge suppression + unit test PR (samir-sec + maya.g). 4) Update rotation runbook to include verification steps (maya.g).

samir-sec: :thumbsup: I'll do 1 and 3. ETA ~2h.

eva-sre: I'll draft the smoke test and runbook updates in `infra/ci` repo. ETA EOD.

maya.g: Thanks everyone. Current downtime 18m; filing a postmortem only if we exceed 30m. Please add any extra follow-ups to INC-2026.

security-bot: SEC-452 updated — policy diff attached. Marking for review.

maya.g: PR and ticket linked. Closing this thread once INC-2026 is resolved and PR merged.
